work.title: COMPONENT SYSTEM
work.subtitle: A Context Card anatomy and variant-rule reference
work.scope: A fictional Context Card component specification. Slot and variant rules are authored requirements, not a shipped component library or accessibility certification.

pages.title: Give the component one clear responsibility.
pages.lead: Context Card groups a note with a source reference and a visible context state. It is a fictional specification for a reusable content unit, not a functioning UI library.
pages.body: The component should explain the relationship without claiming that a link proves source ownership or that a successful render proves accessible behavior. Keep its responsibility narrower than an entire reading workspace.
pages.detail: The model defines five slots and three mutually exclusive variants. Implementation and assistive-technology verification remain future work.
pages.question: What belongs inside this component, and what does not?

records.label: Owns
records.prompt: The local presentation of a note-source relationship.

records.label: Does not own
records.prompt: Authentication, source rights, navigation history or cloud storage.

records.label: Deliverable
records.prompt: An inspectable anatomy and rule set, not a packaged widget.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Index slots and variants before drawing states.
pages.lead: The five slots are heading, source, body, action and status. Default, expanded and unavailable are the three modeled variants. They describe context presentation, not the note editor's save state.
pages.body: Default offers an expansion action. Expanded exposes context with a collapse action. Unavailable shows a reason without an action. Avoid mixing these names with loading or save-result tokens from another contract.
pages.detail: Slot presence and slot meaning are separate. A visually present action must still have a meaningful label and an appropriate interaction behavior.
pages.question: Can a consumer find the rule for each slot?

records.label: Slots
records.prompt: Heading, source, body, action and status.

records.label: Variants
records.prompt: Default, expanded and unavailable are mutually exclusive.

records.label: Boundary
records.prompt: No pending, authenticated or persisted variant is supplied.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Describe the anatomy as content relationships.
pages.lead: Heading names the note; source names its reference; body holds the note text. Action changes the context presentation where available, and status explains the current variant in words.
pages.body: Do not encode the relationship only through position or color. A source that moves beneath the body on a narrow surface should retain a clear textual association with the note.
pages.detail: A future implementation must select appropriate semantics for its actual host page. This document does not prescribe a heading level independently of surrounding content.
pages.question: Which relationship must survive a layout change?

records.label: Heading / body
records.prompt: Identify the note and preserve the note text.

records.label: Source
records.prompt: Explain what the reference relates to without inventing provenance.

records.label: Action / status
records.prompt: Name the available change and the current context condition.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Define properties with constrained values.
pages.lead: Variant accepts default, expanded or unavailable. The heading, source and body are required non-empty strings in this authored schema. The unavailable reason is required only for the unavailable variant.
pages.body: Action label is derived from the variant rather than independently supplied: Show context, Hide context or no action. Conflicting labels and variant values must be rejected or normalized by an explicit implementation rule.
pages.detail: The source records store derived visibility and action text. They are a specification fixture, not a runtime validator shipped to consumers.
pages.question: Could a consumer create a contradictory combination?

records.label: Required
records.prompt: Heading, source and body must contain non-whitespace text.

records.label: Enum
records.prompt: Variant is exactly default, expanded or unavailable.

records.label: Conditional
records.prompt: Unavailable requires a reason and supplies no action.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Keep the three variants internally consistent.
pages.lead: Default hides the context excerpt and offers Show context. Expanded reveals the context excerpt and offers Hide context. Unavailable hides it, omits the action and requires a reason.
pages.body: The source fixture sets action_enabled true only for default and expanded. Hidden content is not represented as an empty visible field. A real implementation must define focus and announcement behavior when presentation changes.
pages.detail: Three rows define the complete fixture. There is no approved fourth combination with an unavailable message and an enabled expansion action.
pages.question: Can every variant be explained without a screenshot?

records.label: Default
records.prompt: Context hidden; Show context action enabled.

records.label: Expanded
records.prompt: Context visible; Hide context action enabled.

records.label: Unavailable
records.prompt: Context hidden; no action; explanation required.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Compose cards without losing identity.
pages.lead: A list can contain several cards, but each needs its own note identity and context state. Expanding one should not silently change every card unless that behavior is explicitly specified.
pages.body: Use stable keys for actual instances and keep source association local to each card. Do not infer identity from visible position; sorting or filtering can change that position.
pages.detail: This reference defines no global expand-all control, virtualization behavior or collection data model. Those require separate interaction contracts.
pages.question: What should stay stable when cards are reordered?

records.label: Identity
records.prompt: Use an instance identity separate from the display order.

records.label: Isolation
records.prompt: One card's presentation state must not overwrite another's.

records.label: Excluded
records.prompt: No bulk action or list persistence behavior is implemented here.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Write labels that describe the action's result.
pages.lead: Show context and Hide context name opposite changes to the same content. Avoid a vague More label when several different things could expand. An unavailable reason should explain the actual limitation without blaming the reader.
pages.body: Do not show a success sentence where no save happened. The card's context variant and the note's persistence status are separate concepts even when both appear on the same screen.
pages.detail: Use source labels that fit the material actually supplied. A citation-shaped string is not verified provenance merely because it is formatted consistently.
pages.question: Could the wording imply a capability the card does not have?

records.label: Action copy
records.prompt: Show context or Hide context, matching the current variant.

records.label: Unavailable copy
records.prompt: Describe the missing context and any real next step.

records.label: Avoid
records.prompt: No saved, verified source or permission claim without evidence.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Treat accessibility as implementation work.
pages.lead: The proposed control should have a meaningful name, a visible focus treatment and an explicit expanded relationship where applicable. Text must remain readable when content grows and the layout reflows.
pages.body: These are review questions and requirements, not a WCAG pass. Keyboard activation, focus order, announcements, contrast and reading order must be checked against the implemented host and its actual content.
pages.detail: Removing an unavailable action must not strand focus. The specification has not implemented or tested that transition, so record it as an unresolved integration question.
pages.question: What needs a real implementation before it can be verified?

records.label: Semantics
records.prompt: Choose actual control and heading semantics in host context.

records.label: Behavior
records.prompt: Verify keyboard, focus and expanded-state announcements.

records.label: Status
records.prompt: No conformance test or assistive-technology result is claimed.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Specify the implementation boundary explicitly.
pages.lead: Consumers provide content and a valid variant. A future component emits a context-toggle intent for available variants; the host owns the state change. Unavailable emits no toggle intent.
pages.body: Do not let a presentational component fetch sources or silently persist notes. Such behavior would add error, permission and lifecycle responsibilities not covered by this three-row fixture.
pages.detail: Define a stable payload containing the instance identity if integrating a real event callback. No executable package, event bus or API endpoint is delivered by this document.
pages.question: Which responsibility belongs to the host rather than the card?

records.label: Input
records.prompt: Content strings, instance identity and a valid variant.

records.label: Intent
records.prompt: A bounded request to toggle context when an action exists.

records.label: Host
records.prompt: Own state updates, retrieval and any real persistence decisions.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.

pages.title: Version the rule change, not just the drawing.
pages.lead: Version 0.1 describes this authored three-variant fixture. A new pending variant would change the enum, property dependencies, action rules, tests and content guidance, not merely add a spinner.
pages.body: Keep a change record that explains the compatibility impact. Existing consumers must not receive an unfamiliar variant while the documentation still claims only three accepted values.
pages.detail: The fixture can be internally consistent without being complete for a product. Extension should follow a known need and a revised contract.
pages.question: What must change together when a variant is added?

records.label: Current
records.prompt: Five slots and three mutually exclusive context variants.

records.label: Change set
records.prompt: Schema, action copy, source matrix and review tests.

records.label: Limit
records.prompt: No shipped consumers, migration or production compatibility verified.

evidenceRows: 5 slots, 3 exclusive variants. Authored requirements, not a shipped library.
